read: the close fell 9.65% from saturday 24 october to saturday 31 october, after rising 2.01% the week before. it sits 7.72% below the 50 week average, after 1.41% above it a week earlier. in the 52 weeks our series carries that line, since 2 november 2025, it is the only week that lost both the 21 week and the 50 week average in one step. hashrate read 368.09 PH/s on saturday 31 october and averaged 356.32 PH/s from 25 to 31 october, against 361.41 PH/s from 18 to 24 october, in our own daily log.
